links.outcome: LLM extraction accuracy of CAR-T adverse events versus dual-annotator ground truth
links.effect: CRS and ICANS grading accuracy 0.97 and 0.91; prespecified AE accuracies 0.62-0.76; non-prespecified AE accuracies 0.76-0.84; kappa 0.86-0.96 for CRS/ICANS.
links.quote: Performance was high on CRS and ICANS grading (accuracy of 0.97 and 0.91, respectively).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation/validation of GPT-4 zero-shot extraction of adverse event details from unstructured clinical EHR notes of CAR-T therapy patients, benchmarked against human annotators without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard or comparing workflows.
